A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (22 January 2023). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-D-deathstartractorbeam-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Death Star Tractor Beam (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 17 August 2019): The game text changes: “Star Cruiser)” becomes “star cruiser)”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again; the bronze disc is gone and the mark “D-E1” is printed in the black lower border.

The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2023 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
